verdict.rationale: Grafana's own docs call it "Grafana Open Source Software (OSS)", and independent community sources confirm the code is published under AGPL, a FOSS license (one user notes it switched "from one FOSS license to another"). Some commenters raise legal-compliance concerns about AGPL, but those concern usage terms and do not contradict that the source is readable under an open license. Missing for 10: first-party evidence citing the license file or terms directly, and clarity on which components (e.g. Enterprise or Cloud-only features) fall outside the open-source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Grafana 8 is the first release under AGPL.
Grafana switched from one FOSS license to another
